findings.evidence: Only exact CI=true/GITHUB_ACTIONS=true/public repository context can enter. Only a validated ordinary nonsymlink checkout/config layout is admitted; full-history contexts perform no fetch. One fixed public HTTPS repository/all-heads refspec writes only an isolated local remote-ref namespace. It does not query origin values, credential helpers, environment secrets or private provider configuration. Redirects, cookies, hooks, authentication headers, helpers, auto-maintenance and retries are disabled by the fixed command/environment. No production/app entrypoint exists.

Git enables optional netrc use and libcurl can fall back to the account home when HOME is omitted. The helper now creates a fresh empty canonical0700 child-only home/XDG directory and NETRC=devNull, with no ambient HOME lookup or process/shell environment mutation. It validates emptiness before and after the attempted fetch and removes only its own temporary directory in finally on success/failure.

An independent actual local non-secret fixture showed ordinary rev-parse and --local config commands follow a malformed include during Git startup. An explicit config-file/no-includes/name-only audit from the empty isolated non-repository child cwd with a fixed discovery ceiling safely returns only key names. The final helper uses that audit first, rejects include/helper/rewrite/partial-clone/unsupported keys, then permits ordinary checkout metadata probes. The fixture preserves source/config bytes and performs zero network requests.

The first implementation admitted a fake successful last-HEAD acknowledgment at monotonic25001ms. Current code checks remaining time before every command, elapsed time after each acknowledgment and again after cleanup. Late successful fetch or HEAD acknowledgments, lost/failed acknowledgment, changed HEAD, continued shallowness or context withdrawal fail closed. There is at most one fetch invocation and no continuation after uncertainty or source-guard bypass.

Offline native shallow and detached PR-merge fixtures recover the actual old Git blob while preserving current HEAD, dirty/untracked worktree bytes, origin config and FETCH_HEAD. The helper does not substitute files, regenerate evidence or weaken exact source validators. Public anonymous provider execution remains a future exact-head CI observation.

The exact failed artifact demonstrates getByRole(checkbox) matched eight controls. The sole test delta selects the unchanged original explicit disposable-simulation consent label. Every other byte/assertion and original timing budget remain. Nine actual affected cases pass across three brands/three layouts; first infrastructure approval did not execute a test and is not counted as a passing run.

Independent CPU-profile aggregation confirms76.491697s sampled,61.351511s canonical snapshot ancestry and49.673704s synchronous React root work. Hidden Cost/Service inner Review renders account for approximately20.754s/13.238s of that sample. This demonstrates repeated expensive hidden-pane renders; it does not establish an infinite callback loop. Five stable React.memo wrappers retain six original panes and original local state; no custom comparator or authority cache is introduced.

DailyWorkbench itself stays un-memoized. Every parent render retains full pinned canonical/member capture and current-context checks; current=false removes all panes. Identical source-prop references cannot mask native source or membership changes. Changed source/job/callback/focus props and pane-local state still render. The exact source-normalization guard restores the original full body/hash after removing only the finite presentation additions; callbacks, keys, deadlines, source checks and original UNKNOWN custody remain unchanged.

A regression on the simple memo version failed only because the expired owner task reappeared without its original UNKNOWN alert after hiding and advancing past its original five-minute expiry. Final wrappers accept an active presentation prop and strip it before forwarding original props. Six activation predicates match original visibility, including the shared finance/invoice pane. Three real desktop-brand cases now preserve the same owner DOM marker/exact context/expiry, show original UNKNOWN on return, and remove expired task detail/action controls; there is no remount, renewed inspection, callback or custody reset.
